Krasnoyilsk Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Chernivtsi Oblast, Ukraine

Demolished. Jews settled in Krasnoputna (now part of Krasnoilsk) in 1820, with many employed at a local sawmill; the first synagogue was built in 1825, followed by a mikvah and bathhouse. In 1890, the owner of a local glass factory purchased land for this cemetery. By 1930, 160 Jews lived in the town, its children optionally attending heders for traditional Jewish education after state school; during the German occupation, the community was deported to Transnistria. The cemetery's exact location, determined only through oral testimony of local residents, still requires further confirmation.
